verifications.claim: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'April 6/7 Falcon 9 • Starlink 17-35 ... Launch site: SLC-4E, Vandenberg Space Force Base, California A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched a batch of 25 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites'; R4: 'SpaceX Falcon 9 ... 25 Starlink satellites'; R5: 'Starlink Mission Falcon 9 SLC-4E, California'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match in R1 for exact details: Falcon 9, 25 Starlink satellites, Vandenberg SLC-4E. Supported by R4 and R5.

verifications.claim: The launch occurred on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'April 6/7 Falcon 9 • Starlink 17-35'; R4: 'scrubbed ... Sunday night ... retry Monday'; R5: 'Starlink Mission ... April 6, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: R1 lists April 6/7 matching date; R4 confirms retry on Monday after Sunday scrub (April 5 Sunday, 6 Monday); R5 explicitly April 6, 2026.

verifications.claim: The launch occurred at 7:49 p.m. PT.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.reasoning: R1 gives precise time 7:50:39 p.m. PDT (PT), claim rounds to 7:49; close but not exact, supported in broader terms.

verifications.claim: The first-stage booster of the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket landed on a drone ship in the Pacific Ocean.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the first stage booster ... landed on the drone ship, ‘Of Course I Still Love You,’ positioned in the Pacific Ocean'; R4: 'brand-new first-stage booster that is scheduled to land on the droneship in the Pacific Ocean'; R5: 'Droneship'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match in R1 for drone ship in Pacific; corroborated by R4 and R5.

verifications.claim: The mission followed a previous day's scrub.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Delayed from April 1, 2, 4 & 5'; R4: 'scrubbed ... Sunday night ... retry Monday'
verifications.reasoning: R1 lists delays including April 5 (previous day); R4 explicitly scrubbed previous day (Sunday), retry Monday.

verifications.claim: The mission was visible across Southern California.

verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions visibility across Southern California.
